page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8v.48xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance based on the x86_64 CPU architecture managed by a KVM hypervisor. The host infrastructure is powered by Intel Xeon 8469C processors operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The configuration delivers 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1024 GB of system memory, providing an allocation ratio of 5.33 GB RAM per core.

The hardware payload features an acceleration array consisting of 8 GPUs with a total video memory of 768 GB VRAM. Network capabilities are defined by a baseline bandwidth of 170 Gbps. The instance provides no bundled local disk storage, requiring all persistent storage and operational file systems to be attached over the network.

The configuration prioritizes high accelerator capacity and network throughput over local storage availability. Combining 768 GB VRAM with 170 Gbps networking minimizes communication bottlenecks across distributed nodes. This profile is suited for deep learning training, large language model inference, GPU-accelerated data science tasks, and compute-heavy parallel workloads.
